subject: Coverage call, Lisan only: the executive call with counts and the recognisability rule (reviewed; dispatch is Nova's after Ziggy's look)
body:
Correction applied: the call is scoped to Lisan Al Gaib; the two Hon Dolo sets drafted before your d364128a are held in a separate section for the day Nova's Comfy proof of concept lands, and nothing Hon Dolo is dispatched by it.

The file: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/projects/lisan_al_gaib/story/writer_pass_20261012/COVERAGE_CALL_20261013.md, sha256 5f8c05f7b1d03030b696e71f0bbe1b45a09a2f6b59881b94a323c0a008ade5ed, 17,490 bytes. It was audited by two read-only reviewers and a reconciler against the locks, the anchors on disk and the decisions record; fourteen fixes are applied and listed in its section 4 (the ones that matter to your team: the C18 anchor path is the standalone GROK-LAG-1K-C18 package, not G1; the repaired C13-04 puts the maw over his LEFT shoulder, so the sandworm set's over-the-shoulder and profile are on his right and any left-side frame is a marked crossing; the repaired frame has no sun disc, so its key is the haze, not an upper-left sun).

Your question, in one paragraph (section 0 of the file): when the throat worms and the AL and GAIB marks are out of view he is carried by what faces each way. From his left: the three piercings (ear hoop, nostril hoop, brow ring) and the left-arm worm when the sleeve is up. From his right: the breather when worn (one tube across his right cheek into the hair, no rear connector) and otherwise the bare cheek with the jaw and stubble. From behind: the curls above the black hood line, the black cloak over the tan suit, the gold chain's line at the nape, the prop in his hand and his walk. And by cutting: at least one frame in three in any set is a frontal, three-quarter or profile that carries a face-side identity, so an edit re-anchors him every few shots. Section 1 rule 5 has the full table by angle.

The Lisan list with counts (22 slots a set, each a different angle and action, never 22 variants of one angle; file names <SET>-<nn>_<angle>_<action>_<bot>.jpg; MANIFEST with angle, action, anchor_file, anchor_sha256; every return preliminary; Nova intakes):
  LAG-COV-00  Lisan turnaround, signature look (first; no turnaround exists): chest-up F, 3QL, 3QR, PL, PR, 3QBL, 3QBR, B (8); full body the same eight (8); breather on PR, 3QR, 3QBR (3); hood up F, PL, B (3). Anchors: LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg, LAG-LOOK-V3-01.jpg, LAG-LOCK-ARM-SH13.jpg (left-arm art only).
  LAG-COV-01  the sandworm beat: eleven angles, each as a still and as a mid-action (22). Anchor: the repaired C13-04 best, pending Ziggy's look at that frame.
  LAG-COV-02  Story 01's vault and the lattice: eleven, then the same eleven under the storm's light (22). Anchors: the C18 team picks 14, 18, 19, 20, 22.
  LAG-COV-03  the mirror room: eleven, then eleven with the hood up (22). Anchor: LAG-SC-01 with its known defects corrected, not inherited.
  Then the bazaar and the camp (C17, C25, C31, C36), the dune and the furrow (C32, C24, C15); bosses and the enforcer last, after Ziggy's IP call.
Every slot in the file names its action, its key as a source, its camera and its side of the line.

Sequence from here: Ziggy reads it (sent to him); Nova dispatches LAG-COV-00 first under the production method; your team generates nothing until her dispatch arrives. Two new recurring characters Ziggy named tonight from the song's own lines, Angels and Sassy, are in a writer's note and are NOT in any request yet; rule 7 bars new characters until their note is read and looks exist.

Shape 16: your 2175a9f5 is read; recorded as a known defect with zC2 still best; if Ziggy keeps the shape the next request asks for a video-model or inpaint route, not more stills. Nothing accepted.

attachments.description: The coverage call, Lisan only, reviewed (fourteen fixes applied, section 4); Hon Dolo sets held in section 3.
